## BROKER BIO

Use this exact text on the Advisor Bio page:

Jessie Eagen is one of the most seasoned and experienced Real Estate
agents in the Missoula area. Surviving 32+ years in Montana real
estate, with the economic twists and turns, has proven to be a great
accomplishment for Jessie. Since his first house sale in 1993 for
$112,000, Jessie has remained focused and determined to be a leader
in his field. He has combined his dedication and experience to make a
giant footprint in the Residential, Commercial & Investment, and
Flathead Lake markets the past 32 years and he continues to raise his
personal bar to deliver excellence in every transaction.

Jessie has always been heavily involved in all aspects of real estate,
from development of new multi-family projects, building spec homes,
consulting on residential developments to buying and selling homes for
himself. With his well-rounded experience in all areas of the
industry, Jessie prides himself on being an aggressive negotiator with
the foresight in knowing how to get the deal done. He finds the right
buyers, the right sellers, the right investors, the right property and
he brings it all to you.

Jessie's personable and professional character allow him to build and
maintain solid relationships, which explains why his business has
grown mostly from referrals and repeat clients. He uses sound
knowledge, cutting edge technology, tried wisdom, tenacity and a good
amount of hustle to achieve the goals and expectations of his clients.

Jessie was born and raised in Great Falls, MT. After graduating from
University of Montana with a Business degree, Jessie began his real
estate career in 1992 and made Missoula home. He spends his time
between his hometown of Missoula and his favorite place in the world,
Flathead Lake.

## MARKET CONTEXT

Primary markets: Missoula urban core, Hip Strip (S Higgins Ave),
Reserve Street corridor, Brooks Street retail, Missoula County
including Lolo, Florence, Stevensville.

Key demand drivers:
- University of Montana (largest employer, 12,000+ students)
- St. Patrick Hospital, Community Medical Center
- Limited commercial inventory in core corridors
- Strong owner-user and regional investor demand
- Seasonal tourism and outdoor recreation economy

Market tone (2025-2026):
- Retail investment market stable, continued demand for
  well-located assets
- Higher interest rates moderated some investor activity
  but not killed demand
- Hip Strip and downtown assets command premium pricing
- Industrial and flex seeing strong demand, limited supply
- Office market softer, owner-user deals more active

    <p class="biot">Jessie Eagen is one of the most seasoned and experienced Real Estate agents in the Missoula area. Since his first house sale in 1993 for $112,000, Jessie has remained focused and determined to be a leader in his field. He has combined his dedication and experience to make a giant footprint in the Residential, Commercial &amp; Investment, and Flathead Lake markets the past 32 years and he continues to raise his personal bar to deliver excellence in every transaction.</p>
    <p class="biot">Jessie has always been heavily involved in all aspects of real estate, from development of new multi-family projects, building spec homes, consulting on residential developments to buying and selling homes for himself. With his well-rounded experience in all areas of the industry, Jessie prides himself on being an aggressive negotiator with the foresight in knowing how to get the deal done. He finds the right buyers, the right sellers, the right investors, the right property and he brings it all to you.</p>
    <p class="biot">Jessie&#39;s personable and professional character allow him to build and maintain solid relationships, which explains why his business has grown mostly from referrals and repeat clients. He uses sound knowledge, cutting edge technology, tried wisdom, tenacity and a good amount of hustle to achieve the goals and expectations of his clients.</p>
    <p class="biot">Jessie was born and raised in Great Falls, MT. After graduating from University of Montana with a Business degree, Jessie began his real estate career in 1992 and made Missoula home. He spends his time between his hometown of Missoula and his favorite place in the world, Flathead Lake.</p>

## VARIABLE REFERENCE

When populating the template, replace these variables:

Property: ADDRESS_LINE1, CITY_STATE_ZIP, FULL_ADDRESS, ASSET_TYPE,
BUILDING_SF, ACREAGE, TOUR_DATE, CLIENT_NAME, ENTITY_NAME

Valuation: VALUE_LOW, VALUE_LOW_PSF, VALUE_HIGH, VALUE_HIGH_PSF,
LIST_PRICE, LIST_PRICE_PSF, MARKET_DURATION

Narrative: EXEC_SUMMARY_P1, EXEC_SUMMARY_P2, TARGET_BUYER_P1,
TARGET_BUYER_P2, VALUE_CONSIDERATIONS (as <li> tags),
HIGHEST_BEST_USE, OPTIMAL_BUYER, RISKS, MARKET_OUTLOOK,
COMP_OVERVIEW_1, COMP_OVERVIEW_2, PUBLIC_FUNDING,
FINANCING_P1, FINANCING_P2

Financials: FIN_PRICE, FIN_PSF, FIN_CAP, FIN_RETURN, FIN_OPEX, FIN_NOI

Rent Roll: RENT_ROLL_ROWS (as <tr> tags), RR_TOTAL_SF, RR_TOTAL_PCT,
RR_TOTAL_PSF, RR_TOTAL_MKT, RR_TOTAL_MKTSF, RR_TOTAL_ANNUAL,
RR_AVG_SF, RR_AVG_PCT, RR_AVG_PSF, RR_AVG_ANNUAL

Comps: COMP_ROWS_PAGE_1 (subject + comps 1-3 as .cor divs),
COMP_PAGE_2_HTML (comps 4-6 page or empty string if <4 comps),
COMPS_SUMMARY_ROWS (as <tr> tags),
COMP_AVG_PRICE, COMP_AVG_BLDG, COMP_AVG_LOT

Demographics: DEMOGRAPHICS_ROWS, POPULATION_ROWS, HOUSEHOLD_ROWS

Photos (use <img src="URL"> or placeholder div):
COVER_PHOTO_HTML, EXEC_PHOTO_HTML, FINANCING_PHOTO_HTML,
HEADSHOT_HTML, DIVIDER_PHOTO_1_HTML through DIVIDER_PHOTO_4_HTML

Logo: Replace LOGO_SRC_PLACEHOLDER with the base64 src above.
